subject: Withdrawal from {name}
preview: {name} submitted a withdrawal with the withdrawal function on {submittedAt}.
heading: A customer withdrew from a contract
intro: {name} submitted a withdrawal statement with the withdrawal function on {submittedAt}. Refunds stay your decision: nothing was refunded or revoked automatically.

channel.public: The order number and email address, without signing in

eligibility.statutoryWithdrawal: The right of withdrawal applies: no consent to immediate supply was recorded, and the statement arrived within the {days}-day period.
eligibility.refundable: The full refund before first use applies: the buyer consented to immediate supply, but the CLI had not downloaded templates with the licence when the statement arrived within the {days}-day period.
eligibility.used: Neither applies: the buyer consented to immediate supply, and the CLI had downloaded templates with the licence before the statement arrived.
eligibility.expired: Neither applies: the statement arrived after the {days}-day period.
eligibility.unmatched: Unknown: no active licence matches this order number with this email address or the signed-in account. Find the order in Polar by hand.

acknowledgement.notSent: Not sent. Send the customer an acknowledgement of receipt with the content of this statement and the date and time of its submission.

next: If the withdrawal applies, refund the order in Polar no later than {deadline}: a full refund revokes the licence key. Reply to the customer either way.
openAccount: Open the account in the admin
